text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好，欢迎来到《真实简易英语》，
zh_hant: 大家好，歡迎來到《真實簡易英語》，

text: the podcast where we have real conversations.
zh: 这档播客里有真实的对话。
zh_hant: 這檔播客裡有真實的對話。

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简易英语帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡易英語幫助你學習。

text: I'm Beth.
And I'm Neil.
There is a video version of this podcast on our website,
zh: 这档播客在我们的网站上有视频版本，
zh_hant: 這檔播客在我們的網站上有影片版本，

text: where you can also find a worksheet and transcript to help you learn.
zh: 你还可以在那里找到工作表和学习文本。
zh_hant: 你還可以在那裡找到工作表和學習文字。

text: It's at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil, how are you?
I'm hungry.
Me too.
I'm starving.
Well, that's good, because we're talking about lunch today.
zh: 好啊，这正好，因为今天我们聊午餐。
zh_hant: 好啊，這正好，因為今天我們聊午餐。

text: We're recording this just before lunch,
zh: 我们是在午饭前录制的，
zh_hant: 我們是在午飯前錄製的，

text: so it's no wonder that we're both very hungry.
zh: 所以难怪我们俩都很饿。
zh_hant: 所以難怪我們倆都很餓。

text: You might be able to hear our tummies rumble because we're hungry.
zh: 你可能能听到我们肚子咕咕叫，因为我们饿了。
zh_hant: 你可能能聽到我們肚子咕咕叫，因為我們餓了。

text: OK.
So, shall we begin?
Yes.
Let's do it.
What have you got for lunch today?
for my lunch,
I have chicken with potatoes
and vegetables
in a harissa paste.
Oh, that sounds really nice.
Yeah, it's leftovers actually, which I have heated up
zh: 是啊，其实是剩菜，我加热了，
zh_hant: 是啊，其實是剩菜，我加熱了，

text: and brought in in a little flask.
zh: 然后装在保温瓶里带来了。
zh_hant: 然後裝在保溫瓶裡帶來了。

text: What are leftovers ?
Good question.
That's food from a meal that you've already
zh: 就是你已经吃过的某一餐剩下的
zh_hant: 就是你已經吃過的某一餐剩下的

text: had that you didn't finish,
and you can heat it up and eat it again.
zh: 你可以加热后再吃一次。
zh_hant: 你可以加熱後再吃一次。

text: Yes.
I also have leftovers for my lunch today.
zh: 我今天中午也带了剩菜。
zh_hant: 我今天中午也帶了剩菜。

text: So, yesterday I made a pasta
for lunch with vegetables in it
and I have that.
So, Beth, what do you usually have for lunch?
zh: 贝丝，你平时午饭吃什么？
zh_hant: 貝絲，你平時午飯吃什麼？

text: Is it usually leftovers or something else?
It's usually leftovers when I come into work
zh: 我上班的时候通常吃剩菜，
zh_hant: 我上班的時候通常吃剩菜，

text: because it's easier,
and then I don't need to buy lunch.
But if I go out and buy food,
zh: 但如果我出去买食物的话，
zh_hant: 但如果我出去買食物的話，

text: then I would usually go
for something like sushi or ramen.
zh: 买寿司或拉面之类的东西。
zh_hant: 買壽司或拉麵之類的東西。

text: What about you?
What do you usually have for lunch?
Yeah.
Sometimes I have leftovers that I bring in.
Sometimes, I buy a sandwich, for example.
zh: 有时候我会买个三明治之类的。
zh_hant: 有時候我會買個三明治之類的。

text: What's your favourite kind of sandwich?
If I have a sandwich, if I buy a sandwich for lunch,
zh: 如果我买个三明治当午餐的话，
zh_hant: 如果我買個三明治當午餐的話，

text: I like to get things like smoked salmon.
zh: 我喜欢买烟熏三文鱼的那种。
zh_hant: 我喜歡買菸燻三文魚的那種。

text: Nice.
With pickles maybe, yeah.
There's a really good baguette I like actually
zh: 其实我特别喜欢一家法棍面包店，
zh_hant: 其實我特別喜歡一家法棍麵包店，

text: that has smoked salmon
and egg mayonnaise in it.
Oh, it's so nice.
Stop it.
Sorry.
I'm so hungry.
Me too.
Neil, do you ever skip lunch?
zh: 尼尔，你跳过午饭不吃吗？
zh_hant: 尼爾，你跳過午飯不吃嗎？

text: No way.
I would be in a horrible mood if I skipped lunch.
zh: 要是我不吃午饭，心情会糟透了。
zh_hant: 要是我不吃午飯，心情會糟透了。

text: I don't understand how anyone can skip any meal.
zh: 我不理解怎么会有人不吃任何一餐。
zh_hant: 我不理解怎麼會有人不吃任何一餐。

text: I need to eat all my meals.
Yeah.
Otherwise, you get hangry.
zh: 不然你会变得又饿又气。
zh_hant: 不然你會變得又餓又氣。

text: Exactly.
'Hangry' is hungry and angry.
I'm on the…
I'm almost getting hangry now.
zh: 我现在都快又饿又气了。
zh_hant: 我現在都快又餓又氣了。

text: What's your favourite meal?
Is it lunch?
Breakfast?
Dinner?
I think the evening meal is probably my favourite because we
zh: 我觉得晚餐可能是我最喜欢的，因为我们会
zh_hant: 我覺得晚餐可能是我最喜歡的，因為我們會

text: sit at the table
and chat and it's the biggest, nicest meal of the day
zh: 聊天，而且这是一天中最丰盛最美味的饭，
zh_hant: 聊天，而且這是一天中最豐盛最美味的飯，

text: and you don't really have to do anything after so you can relax.
zh: 吃完后也不用再做什么，可以放松。
zh_hant: 吃完後也不用再做什麼，可以放鬆。

text: Yeah that's good.
I really like brunch which is that sort of in between breakfast and lunch,
zh: 我真的很喜欢早午餐，就是早餐和午餐之间的那一顿，
zh_hant: 我真的很喜歡早午餐，就是早餐和午餐之間的那一頓，

text: maybe 10:00.
And I might have eggs
and bacon and hash browns and avocado,
a big meal full of lots of good food, like a brunch.
zh: 美味丰富的一大餐，就像早午餐那样。
zh_hant: 美味豐富的一大餐，就像早午餐那樣。

text: Do you ever have a working lunch ?
zh: 你吃过边工作边吃的午餐吗？
zh_hant: 你吃過邊工作邊吃的午餐嗎？

text: I do occasionally if I'm working from home
zh: 我在家工作时偶尔会这样，
zh_hant: 我在家工作時偶爾會這樣，

text: because I can carry on working and eat quickly.
zh: 因为可以一边工作一边快速吃饭。
zh_hant: 因為可以一邊工作一邊快速吃飯。

text: And then in my actual lunch break,
zh: 而在真正的午休时间里，
zh_hant: 而在真正的午休時間裡，

text: I might have a nice long walk or something like that,
zh: 我可能会去散个长步之类的，
zh_hant: 我可能會去散個長步之類的，

text: but when I'm in the office, I don't want to eat at my desk.
zh: 但如果在办公室，我不想在办公桌前吃饭。
zh_hant: 但如果在辦公室，我不想在辦公桌前吃飯。

text: No. Me neither.
I don't really like working lunches .
zh: 我不太喜欢边工作边吃午饭。
zh_hant: 我不太喜歡邊工作邊吃午飯。

text: I would rather eat my lunch without working.
zh: 我更愿意不工作专心吃饭。
zh_hant: 我更願意不工作專心吃飯。

text: Yeah, I'd prefer the same, really.
zh: 没错，我其实也是这样的。
zh_hant: 沒錯，我其實也是這樣的。

text: We heard 'working
lunch',
which is when you eat your lunch while you're working.
zh: 就是指一边工作一边吃午饭。
zh_hant: 就是指一邊工作一邊吃午飯。

text: We also had 'leftovers', which is when you don't finish a meal,
so you have more of it at a different time, like the next day.
zh: 就是某一顿饭没吃完，然后在另一个时间再吃，比如第二天。
zh_hant: 就是某一頓飯沒吃完，然後在另一個時間再吃，比如第二天。

text: And we talked about which meals and food we prefer.
zh: 我们还聊了更喜欢哪一餐、哪些食物。
zh_hant: 我們還聊了更喜歡哪一餐、哪些食物。

text: If you prefer something, you like it better than something else.
zh: 如果你prefer某样东西，就是你相比其他更喜欢它。
zh_hant: 如果你prefer某樣東西，就是你相比其他更喜歡它。

text: Yes.
And another phrase we can use to say this is 'would rather'.
zh: 另一个能表达这个意思的短语是 'would rather'。
zh_hant: 另一個能表達這個意思的短語是 'would rather'。

text: For example, I 'd rather have sushi than a sandwich for lunch.
zh: 比如，午饭我宁愿吃寿司，而不是三明治。
zh_hant: 比如，午飯我寧願吃壽司，而不是三明治。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《真实简易英语》就到这里了。
zh_hant: 本期《真實簡易英語》就到這裡了。

text: Test what you've learned with a worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 用我们网站bbclearningenglish.com上的工作表检验你的学习成果。
zh_hant: 用我們網站bbclearningenglish.com上的工作表檢驗你的學習成果。

text: And make sure you join us again for another easy English conversation.
zh: 别忘了下次再来听一期简易英语对话。
zh_hant: 別忘了下次再來聽一期簡易英語對話。

text: We'll be back next week.
See you soon.
Goodbye.
